<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="20" x2="326" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="18" x2="331" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="16" x2="336" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="14" x2="341" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="21" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="21" x2="360" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="15" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="17" width="12" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="387" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,61 20,69 28,77" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="44" y="76" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Create account</text>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="108" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Join the IMDb community and discover more.</text>

  <!-- Username -->
  <text x="20" y="136" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Username</text>
  <rect x="19" y="143" width="352" height="42" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="20" y="142" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="168" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Choose a username</text>

  <!-- Email -->
  <text x="20" y="207" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Email address</text>
  <rect x="19" y="214" width="352" height="42" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="20" y="213" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="239" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">name@example.com</text>

  <!-- Password -->
  <text x="20" y="278" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Password</text>
  <rect x="19" y="285" width="352" height="42" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="20" y="284" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="310" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">At least 8 characters</text>
  <circle cx="348" cy="305" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="311" x2="359" y2="316" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.4"/>

  <!-- Confirm password -->
  <text x="20" y="349" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Confirm password</text>
  <rect x="19" y="356" width="352" height="42" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="20" y="355" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="381" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">Re-enter your password</text>
  <circle cx="348" cy="376" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="382" x2="359" y2="387" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.4"/>

  <!-- Remember and helper action -->
  <rect x="20" y="414" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#F5C418" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="23,422 27,426 34,418" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="46" y="427" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Remember me</text>
  <text x="280" y="427" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#646F79">Password rules</text>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="448" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="20" y="446" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
    <text x="195" y="476" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Create IMDb account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="20" y1="520" x2="166" y2="520" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="524" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">or continue with</text>
  <line x1="224" y1="520" x2="370" y2="520" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Google button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="538" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="45" y="565" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#4285F4">G</text>
    <text x="195" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Continue with Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Facebook button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="590" width="350" height="42" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="611" r="10" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="46" y="617" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="195" y="616" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Continue with Facebook</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Login prompt and legal -->
  <text x="195" y="664" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Already have an account?</text>
  <text x="195" y="686" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Log in</text>
  <text x="195" y="716" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">By creating an account, you agree to our</text>
  <text x="195" y="735" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#646F79">Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="43,795 51,789 59,795" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="46" y="795" width="10" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="51" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    <!-- Search -->
    <circle cx="132" cy="797" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="137" y1="802" x2="143" y2="808" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="132" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
    <!-- Wishlist -->
    <polygon points="214,793 218,790 222,793 226,790 230,793 230,799 222,807 214,799" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="222" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="311" cy="795" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="311" cy="805" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="311" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#F2C94C">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
